purpose: Curated metadata for foundational Bible study, Christian classics, Baptist history, missions, evangelism, and teaching resources. This file is metadata and review planning only; it does not import full texts into the app UI.
rules: Do not import resources marked do_not_import or rights_review_required.
Do not import false religions, cult literature, or rejected doctrinal-review materials.
Do not remove otherwise useful resources solely because of secondary doctrinal differences.
Use visible warnings such as Use with discernment and Not all doctrine endorsed where appropriate.

resources.title: Webster's 1828 Dictionary
resources.author: Noah Webster
resources.perspective_notes: English dictionary, not a doctrinal authority; useful for KJV-era word meanings.
resources.recommended_use: Primary KJV word lookup dictionary.
resources.notes: Keep existing starter entries and import full data only from a verified downloadable public-domain source file.

resources.title: Easton's Bible Dictionary
resources.author: M. G. Easton
resources.perspective_notes: Useful concise Bible dictionary; verify exact edition and source before import.
resources.recommended_use: Names, places, and concise Bible background.
resources.notes: Do not import until the exact file/source and commercial-use terms are documented.

resources.title: Smith's Bible Dictionary
resources.author: William Smith
resources.perspective_notes: Helpful historical and geographical reference; use as background, not final doctrine.
resources.recommended_use: Bible people, places, customs, and geography.
resources.notes: Review edition and source before import.

resources.title: Nave's Topical Bible
resources.author: Orville J. Nave
resources.perspective_notes: Topical index of Scripture references; keep tied to the KJV Bible text.
resources.recommended_use: Topic tracing, teaching prep, and verse chains.
resources.notes: Treat as topical Bible/cross-reference aid. Verify source file before import.

resources.title: Treasury of Scripture Knowledge
resources.author: Multiple editors
resources.perspective_notes: Verse-centered cross-reference system; best used to compare Scripture with Scripture.
resources.recommended_use: Primary cross-reference source after Bible reading.
resources.notes: Keep current John samples. Full import waits for final rights and quality plan.

resources.title: Halley's Bible Handbook
resources.author: Henry H. Halley
resources.perspective_notes: Helpful handbook format to learn from, but rights and edition status must be reviewed first.
resources.recommended_use: Chapter overview model only until rights permit use.
resources.notes: Do not import current or unclear editions.

resources.title: Unger's Bible Handbook
resources.author: Merrill F. Unger
resources.perspective_notes: Useful comparison model for organization, but likely modern copyrighted material.
resources.recommended_use: Planning reference only; no content import.
resources.notes: Rights review first. Do not import text.
